previous_statement: For a 2-by-2 block matrix Z=(Z_ij), Ruan scalar multiplication and direct-sum axioms give ||[A B]||<=sqrt(2) max{||A||,||B||} (factor through diag(A,B) and the scalar row [1 1]); applying the same argument to the two block rows gives ||Z||<=2 max_ij||Z_ij||. Scalar corner compressions give the reverse individual bounds ||Z_ij||<=||Z||.
new_statement: The 2-by-2 estimates ||Z|| <= 2 max_ij ||Z_ij|| and ||Z_ij|| <= ||Z|| do follow from Ruan's scalar-multiplication and direct-sum axioms, but no such matrix-norm axioms are supplied by def-hcb-datum, def-ha-map, or the two permitted upstream lemmas. Consequently those estimates cannot be derived from this workspace's allowed inputs; the original assertion is withdrawn, and node 1.3.1 (hence the dyadic propagation route) remains unsupported.
